evidence.quote: This is a 3-year program consisting of 6 academic semesters.
All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here);

certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated)
Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (e.g. passport)
Short Resume/CV (personal details, educational background, work experience, language skills, additional skills)

notes: The programme is only offered for the September intake (single-intake). The application deadline of 15 June is stated without a year, so it is recorded as a recurring deadline. The tuition fee is quoted in USD on the programme page (7,000 USD/year); no EUR or HUF amount for this programme is given on the supplied pages.

evidence.quote: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
For your information, this is equivalent to: a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based). an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
Please note, that you are not strictly required to have a language exam certificate, your language skills will be assessed during the entrance interview.

note.fr: Un certificat de fin d'études secondaires et un examen d'entrée écrit et oral en mathématiques (résultat ≥ 75 %) sont exigés. Entre 60 et 75 %, admission possible en année préparatoire.
note.en: A high school certificate and a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics (result ≥ 75%) are required. Between 60% and 75%, admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme is possible.

evidence.quote: high school certificate; entrance examination in mathematics (written and oral)
Results about 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% -admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.
